===Usage===
Paste the following code into the top of an article, filling all known fields:
*<nowiki>{{PlainLink|url=//starwars.fandom.com}}</nowiki> gives {{PlainLink|url=//starwars.fandom.com}}
*<nowiki>{{PlainLink|url=//starwars.fandom.com Wookieepedia}}</nowiki> gives {{PlainLink|url=//starwars.fandom.com Wookieepedia}}
*<nowiki>{{PlainLink|url=//starwars.fandom.com|Wookieepedia}}</nowiki> gives {{PlainLink|url=//starwars.fandom.com|Wookieepedia}}
*<nowiki>{{PlainLink|http://www.google.co.uk|Google}}</nowiki> gives {{PlainLink|http://www.google.co.uk|Google}}

Note that if your url or link title contains an equals sign = you must use named parameters:

<nowiki>{{PlainLink|url=//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Luke_Skywalker?action=edit|name="=" }}</nowiki> gives {{PlainLink|url=//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Luke_Skywalker?action=edit|name="=" }}
